name: Goliath Hatchery
clause: create two 3/3 green Phyrexian Beast creature tokens with toxic 1. / At the beginning of your upkeep, ... draw cards equal to its total toxic value.

needs.proposedSignature: a parameterised keyword everywhere a Keyword[] appears: `grant-keyword.keywords: (Keyword | { keyword: 'toxic'|'bushido'|'rampage'|'ward'|'protection'; amount: number })[]`, the same on `token.keywords`, `aura.keywords`, `anthem.keywords`, `animate.keywords`; plus an Amount `{ prop: 'toxic', of: Ref }`
needs.semantics: Keyword grants that carry the keyword's own magnitude, and an amount that reads a creature's total toxic value (the sum of its toxic instances).
needs.clause: Each other creature you control with toxic gains toxic 1 until end of turn. / Enchanted creature has toxic 2. / two 3/3 green Phyrexian Beast creature tokens with toxic 1 / draw cards equal to its total toxic value
